chains.name: duel_basic
chains.label_zh: 对决基础弧：逼近→测距→攻→防/反→接触→力反馈→状态→追击/终结
chains.label_en: Basic duel arc: approach→measure→attack→defense/counter→contact→feedback→state→follow/finisher

chains.name: clinch_break_punish
chains.label_zh: 缠抱→拆开→惩罚
chains.label_en: Clinch → break → punish

chains.name: feint_commit_punish
chains.label_zh: 佯攻→实打→惩罚落空
chains.label_en: Feint → commit → punish the miss

chains.name: disarm_reclaim
chains.label_zh: 缴械→武器回收或徒手续战
chains.label_en: Disarm → reclaim weapon OR continue empty-hand

chains.name: wall_rebound
chains.label_zh: 击退撞墙→反弹→动量继承续打
chains.label_en: Knockback off wall → rebound → inherit momentum

chains.name: multi_handoff
chains.label_zh: 多人交接：谁打谁、下一拍谁接手
chains.label_en: Multi-opponent handoff / attack ordering

chains.name: aerial_jump
chains.label_zh: 腾空攻击：起跳借力→空中轨迹→落地卸力
chains.label_en: Aerial / jump attack: takeoff force + landing unload

chains.name: weapon_ownership
chains.label_zh: 武器归属：谁握持、脱手后谁捡回
chains.label_en: Ownership: who holds which weapon; who recovers after drop

chains.name: occlusion_reappear
chains.label_zh: 遮挡后入画：仍是同一张脸/服装/武器
chains.label_en: Occlusion then re-ID: same face / costume / weapon

chains.name: facing_swap
chains.label_zh: 换位后相对朝向与左右锁定
chains.label_en: Relative facing / left-right after position swap

chains.name: pursuit_reengage
chains.label_zh: 追击→超步→刹停再交手（对决步法版）
chains.label_en: Pursuit → overtake → brake and re-engage

chains.name: cover_debris
chains.label_zh: 掩体/道具破碎→碎屑状态跨镜继承
chains.label_en: Cover / prop break → debris state inheritance

chains.name: ricochet_geometry
chains.label_zh: 弹刀/格开后刃路几何延续
chains.label_en: Catch / ricochet geometry — deflected path continues

chains.name: injury_state_carry
chains.label_zh: 伤势/状态跨镜继承（伤肩仍受限）
chains.label_en: Combat-state inheritance across shots

chains.name: env_continuity
chains.label_zh: 环境连续：湿石仍湿、尘土留痕
chains.label_en: Environment continuity: wet stone stays wet; dust from prior hit

chains.name: counter_punish
chains.label_zh: 防守反击→惩罚空档
chains.label_en: Defense counter → punish the opening

chains.name: weapon_handoff
chains.label_zh: 主动换手 / 递兵：归属瞬时转移
chains.label_en: Active weapon handoff — ownership transfer

chains.name: face_to_face_duel
chains.label_zh: 面对面交手（朝向锁）
chains.label_en: Face-to-face duel facing lock

chains.name: jump_takeoff_land
chains.label_zh: 有因跳跃：蹬地起跳+落地卸力
chains.label_en: Motivated jump: takeoff force + landing unload

chains.name: spell_aimed_feedback
chains.label_zh: 法术瞄准对手+击中反馈
chains.label_en: Spell aimed at foe + hit feedback

chains.name: cross_shot_identity_space
chains.label_zh: 切镜身份+空间锁（无瞬移无换人）
chains.label_en: Cross-shot identity + spatial locks

chains.name: xyz_coord_duel
chains.label_zh: XYZ坐标对决：开场锁坐标→步法更新→切镜重申→法术沿向量
chains.label_en: XYZ coord duel: lock → footwork update → cut restate → spell along vector

note: TEXT pairs only. Retrain bridge/JEV in ComfyUI with H3 CLIP 5120-d.
